verificationLimits: Native C# FSM/action dispatcher and numeric selector/event labels are unrecovered. Tests prove these explicit scoped adapter laws, not original frame or RNG-generator parity.

Controls do not silently translate to early end; normal completed timer pays, while death/withdrawal/explicit premature finish does not.

S1 each native Dice is mapped to a fresh seeded RNG draw. Conditional control flow is exact; native Dice draw sharing/state is unrecovered. The implied per-step probabilities are .4add/.24minus/.36stay, then three trials; prob_stay is present only in tables and not referenced by source template.

Native talent category3/professionMask1023/purposeNONE numeric dispatcher is not recovered. Nonheal allied live units in original range are used, excluding hidden/unborn/dead; source target-free/isolation exceptions are explicit. No blanket sourceless, periodic, HP-loss or all-elemental immunity is inferred.

S2 ON_OUTPUT_DAMAGE has no IsAttack or type filter. Accepted HP-output mapping includes absorbed0 and arbitrary source HP damage while active, but excludes dodge/cancel/gauge/HPLOSS; source skipSourceEvent and native cancellation/zero-damage/event ordering need executable or recorded-game verification. Born arrows active-at-impact behavior is explicitly bounded.

Original normal/S2 projectile speed10/lifetime10/managedBySource0/stopWhenSourceInvalid0 are preserved. Current source-ATK after withdrawal and invalid-target eligibility are established simulator bridges, not a recovered native dummy-attachment dispatcher.
